title: bardolier doctor output
description: Structured environment findings. cli-spec.md §6 (Lifecycle / SSD). The app calls this on launch, so once the app ships (Phase 5+) changes are ADDITIVE ONLY. doctor exits 0 even when findings fail — see cli/src/model/doctor.ts.

ok.description: True when every finding is ok.

id.description: Stable check id the app may key UI off.

remedy.description: What to do about it. Present only when the finding is actionable.

roots.description: Per-root state. Present only on the `ssd` finding. Additive since phase 18.

removable.description: Whether diskutil reports this as a removable, non-internal volume. Null when the root isn't currently mounted — there is nothing to ask, and the CLI never guesses.
